en.headline: Man faces six charges after e-bike hits boy in Mong Kok
en.dek: Police said a 35-year-old was due to appear in Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Monday over a Friday collision that injured a 10-year-old.
body: A 35-year-old man was due to appear in Kowloon City Magistrates’ Courts on Monday after police charged him over an electric bicycle collision in Mong Kok that injured a 10-year-old boy. Police said the boy was knocked down on Sai Yee Street near Prince Edward Road West on Friday, 11 September, and the rider left the scene.

Officers from the Traffic Kowloon West accident investigation team and a special task force reviewed closed-circuit television and arrested the man, a two-way permit holder, on Saturday afternoon on Argyle Street near Portland Street. The electric bicycle was seized.

Police said he faced six charges: dangerous driving, failing to stop after an accident, driving an unregistered vehicle, driving without a licence, using a vehicle without third-party insurance, and riding without an approved protective helmet. Police condemned leaving an injured child at the scene and repeated that electric mobility devices are not suitable for use on roads, pavements or cycle tracks.

zh.headline: 旺角電動單車撞傷男童逃逸 男子涉6罪提堂
zh.dek: 警方表示，一名35歲男子周一在九龍城裁判法院提堂，案件源於上周五旺角一輛電動單車撞傷10歲男童後不顧而去。
body: 一名35歲男子因旺角電動單車交通意外，周一在九龍城裁判法院提堂。警方指，上周五（9月11日）旺角洗衣街近太子道西，一輛電動單車撞倒一名10歲本地男童，男童手腳擦傷，肇事騎手隨即離開現場。
西九龍總區交通部交通意外調查隊及特遣隊翻查閉路電視後，周六下午在旺角亞皆老街近砸蘭街拘捕該名持雙程證的內地男子，並檨取涉事電動單車。
警方表示，男子被控危險驗駛、意外後不顧而去、驗駛未有登記車輛、沒有驗駛執照、沒有第三者保險而使用車輛，以及驗駛時沒有戴上認可防護頭盔。警方譴責肇事者在他人受傷後逃離現場，並重申電動可移動工具不適合在行車路、行人路或單車徑使用。
